title: FAITH IN HIS NAME
hookText: The Greatest Gift You Can Give
openLoop: What you carry is worth more than silver or gold

recap.title: How healing flows through you
items: Give people the Name above every sickness
You're a filled cup — pour into others
Pray short prayers, full of care
Pray in faith, never by your own holiness

scenes.point: Give them the Name above every sickness, disease and illness
scenes.teaser: Power in His name, word and touch

scenes.point: You're an empty cup He filled — now pour into others
scenes.teaser: Stagnant water stinks — keep it flowing

scenes.point: Jesus' prayers were short — but filled with care
scenes.teaser: He never walked past a need

scenes.point: To the dead He stopped, to the lame He looked, to the blind He spoke
scenes.teaser: But it only works one way

scenes.point: Without faith it's impossible to please God — pray believing
Healing is never about your fame — it's all for Jesus' glory
